query:
SELECT
          d.id,
          d.domain,
          d.created_at,
          d.updated_at,
          (
            u.id,
            u.username,
            u.password_hash,
            u.created_at,
            u.updated_at
          ) AS "owner!: User"
        FROM domains d
        INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = d.owner_id
        WHERE d.owner_id = $1;
